coverage: 14 predetermined cases: 10 training and 4 validation; not all 1064 cases
findings: Inspected edited source, catalog garment, original target and target mask. Catalog garments match target clothing; masks broadly cover the target garments. Edits include sleeve/neckline changes and some changes around arms or pose; these are dataset limitations, not grounds for selecting easier cases.
limitations: Contact-sheet resolution; no identity-disjointness claim, no inspection of every case, no independent human ratings. Input masks technically decoded but not included in these contact sheets.
